en.title: Warehouse fire destroys vehicles and appliances in Culiacán neighborhood; Prosecution opens investigation
en.summary: A fire at a warehouse in a Culiacán neighborhood destroyed vehicles and appliances. Authorities have launched an investigation, with some reports suggesting the fire may have been intentionally set.

stories.title: Internet cuántico: su principal promesa está en la seguridad

en.title: Quantum internet: its main promise lies in security
en.summary: Quantum key distribution technology uses quantum properties to distribute cryptographic keys and detect potential espionage attempts before compromised information is used.

stories.title: Depresión tropical se intensifica a tormenta Isaias

en.title: No information about threat against Nayarit governor, Sheinbaum states; small aircraft had a 'malfunction', she notes
en.summary: President Sheinbaum reported no credible threat against Nayarit's governor after a small aircraft he frequently used disappeared on October 4 and subsequently crashed.

stories.title: AT&T gana un juicio para usar la banda de 3.5 GHz en 5G móvil por todo México

en.summary: France conducted an initial test launch of a nuclear missile while Russia indicated it understood the message behind French President Macron's action.
